title: Gulch and stream sediment removal for flood control
summary: Soil washed down from Kīhei will be reused as cover material at the landfill. About 300,000 cubic yards of sediment in the Kīhei gulches needs to be removed, and a request for more than $20 million to clear three gulches is with the USDA. In April, the committee cut $1 million in expected revenue from a revolving fund to offset $1 million for Kīhei Drainage Master Plan work.
